root_cause: External intelligence was useful but fragmented. Source capability, observed evidence, generic external relevance, tenant exposure, monetary impact, action execution and observed outcomes were not one explicit truth-bounded lineage.

architecture.lineage: source capability -> observed evidence -> canonical external signal -> tenant company impact -> recommendation -> canonical Brain obligation -> verified outcome -> existing compound learning

prevention: Never create a second external signal store, crawler authority, scheduler, task system, outcome ledger or learning store for this capability.
Only public source capability is seeded. CONNECTED/OBSERVED/LIVE require current provider/evidence observations.
Company impact is written only for a real tenant and references a canonical signal.
Monetary values remain NULL unless tenant/company evidence supports them.
Only READY actions backed by SCORED company impact may create a canonical Brain obligation.
FULFILLED means an obligation completed, not that business value was realized.
A candidate becomes DONE only after verified Outcome Memory can be linked.
Portal V2 must show canonical outside-world evidence plus authenticated-tenant impact overlay and explicit unknowns.
